activity_summary: Once you were flat on the bed over the hall, Anne was another woman. She shut the shutter, put a bag of hot bran to the back, and kept her hands there. Then she said it, in this order: you were a great fool, you were to lie still, and she had you. You stayed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Lay flat, and agreed to stay.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Shut the shutter, set the bran, and kept him.

facets.activity: Lay still on the bed over the hall

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: You great fool. Lie still. I have you.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: The plot had an audience. This room does not.
